pageProps.title: Cursed Bunny
pageProps.review: Bora Chung's Cursed Bunny, a 2022 Booker Prize finalist, is a short story collection that offers a unique worldview and the pleasure of deep contemplation through 10 strange and fresh pieces that cross the boundaries of horror and SF.
pageProps.description: The more a thing is used for a curse, the more beautiful it must be made
pageProps.content:
## Review A book I bought because of the advertisement that it was a ```2022 Booker Prize finalist```. It's a collection of short stories by a somewhat unfamiliar Korean author, and all 10 works are abstruse and fresh. I'm not sure whether to call it horror or SF...
It takes some time to read and think about each work. I'd especially like to list the table of contents of this book here.
```txt 1. Cursed Bunny 2. The Head 3. The Cold Finger 4. Embodiment 5. Goodbye, My Love 6. The Snare 7. Scars 8. Home Sweet Home 9. Ruler of the Winds and Sands 10. Reunion ```
